messages:
support_ryan: heads up — tenant 'hemlock' on dedicated quiet-pool-42 is getting a lot of 429s starting ~03:12 UTC. Customer running nightly batch, reported spikes in latency too. :frowning:
autoscale-bot: [notice] attempted scale up for pool quiet-pool-42 at 03:15 UTC but action blocked: tenant_rate_guard flagged tenant hemlock as noisy_neighbor. See trace id: trace-9f3a.
jordan: can you paste a sample 429 body? and the tenant plan id? need to confirm if this is per-tenant limit or pool throttle.
support_ryan: plan_id=enterprise-ssd-2026, sample 429: {"error":"rate_exceeded","detail":"tenant quota exceeded: 120 units remaining:0"}
sasha: quick check — migration job ran last night to convert legacy quotas. looks like a unit mapping mismatch: legacy units were minutes but migration wrote per_hour. that would massively lower allowed QPS.
mia: WTF. so the tenant was supposed to get 3,600/min but now has 3,600/hr. That explains the batch spikes hitting quota almost immediately.
eng-oncall: pls post the exact DB record for the tenant quota (scrub ids) and the config path.
jordan: here — snippet from quotas table (redacted): ```{ "tenant":"hemlock","quota_value":"3600","quota_unit":"hour","burst":200 }``` expected `quota_unit`=`minute`.
sasha: repro steps: 1) run a 5k concurrent token stream job against /v1/generate with tenant header 2) observe 429 at ~30s 3) tokens continue but get rejected due to per-tenant counter. quick curl example:
```bash
for i in {1..200}; do curl -s -H "X-Tenant: hemlock" -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" \
  -d '{"model":"rwd-ggml-1","prompt":"x","max_tokens":50}' https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate &
done
wait
```
support_ryan: customer is blocked in prod. can we apply a temporary fix (bump units) while we patch migration?
mia: temporary fix: update quotas.quota_unit->minute for that tenant + invalidate tenant counters so they don't carry the hourly accumulated usage. but need approval because counters reset has edge effects.
eng-oncall: I can apply a scoped fix for hemlock now. two actions: 1) update DB mapping to `minute` 2) reset the rolling window counter for tenant hemlock. Doing it in maintenance window? this is urgent — doing now with post-facto audit.
jordan: also add a safety patch in the migration script: if legacy_unit in ("min","minute") then map->minute; fallback to minute for ambiguous cases. add unit sanity check and alert on >100x delta.
sasha: noted. I'll draft the migration hotfix PR and a one-off DB migration to fix any other tenants affected. Also create an alert to flag quota_unit values that are inconsistent with plan defaults.
autoscale-bot: [action] scaled-up 2x nodes for quiet-pool-42 at 03:22 UTC (manual override) :thumbsup:
support_ryan: customer confirmed errors dropped after our temporary change and autoscale bump. they're unblocked for tonight. filing follow-up ticket for full root-cause + retro.
mia: add post-mortem checklist: 1) migration unit mapping test 2) DB audit for outlier quotas 3) safety guard in rate-limiter 4) notify billing if units changed for metering 5) run backfill to correct any billing mismatches.
sasha: I'll own the PR and the DB audit. tagging eng-oncall for rollout plan tomorrow. :eyes:
eng-oncall: thanks — will coordinate the rollback/backfill. keep me posted if hemlock sees any regressions. :shipit:
